hero.title: Your clinic visit, from booking to prescription
hero.body: See every price in Egyptian pounds before you book, get a WhatsApp confirmation and reminder, and find your prescriptions and receipts in your account, at every branch.

quick.title: Next available
quick.intro: The soonest free times at each branch.
quick.empty: No free times in the next 2 weeks at this branch.

branches.title: One clinic, every branch
branches.intro: The same records, prices and booking at every location.

journey.title: From booking to prescription
journey.step1Body: Choose a doctor, branch and time, and see the price first. You get a confirmation and a reminder on WhatsApp.
journey.step2Body: Give your name or mobile number at reception. Your booking is already there.
journey.step3Body: Your file, vitals and previous visits are ready for the doctor before you sit down.
journey.step4Body: Your visit summary, prescription and receipt appear in your account.

specialties.title: Find the right specialist
specialties.intro: Prices are shown on every doctor's profile before you book.

promise.title: Care that fits your schedule and budget
promise.point1: Clear prices in EGP before you book
promise.point2: WhatsApp reminders in Arabic or English
promise.point3: Pay a deposit online or everything at the desk
promise.point4: Your visits, prescriptions and receipts in one account

careers.title: Practise with ClinicFlow
careers.body: Run outpatient clinics with front-desk, nursing and billing support at every branch. Apply online and follow your application step by step.
careers.point1: Reception, triage and billing handled by the clinic team
careers.point2: Schedules across branches without double bookings
